buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. OEM authorised service centres should be available in the state. 3. Bidder should be an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or Authorized Dealer of the propose d product 4. Bid specific OEM’s MAF authorisation certificate duly signed by a competent authority should be provided. 5. GEM star rating should be 4.00 or above ( Attach Screen shot) 6. ISO certification for the OEM ( proof required) 7. ISO certification for the Bidder( Proof required) 8. Product should have BIS,EPEAT India and EPR and ROHS certified ( Attach proof) 9. Bidder should have experience in the supply of the same product in government departments wit hin the state( Attach copies of work order and CRAC) and the purchase order copy amounting to at least 50% of the total bid amount for the last two years, for the same quoted Brand or similar. 10. A brochure( Product literature) of the product which is to be supplied must be attached. 11. An onsite demo should be conducted after the Technical evaluation at buyers location. 12. All certificates, documents, and corrigenda as required in the bid/ATC are uploaded. 13. Self-Certification: Attached confirming compliance with all ATC clauses. 14. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by successful bidder at the time of delivery of Good s. 15. The price quoted should be all inclusive of supply and basic installation and all Taxes. 16. The quoted brand must be among the top 5 IDC ranked sellers in the laptop industry in India.

17. The bidder seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant c ategory as per GeM GTC with the bid. Under MSE category, only manufacturers for goods and Servi ce Providers for Services are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purvi ew of this Policy. 18. The product must be among the top 5 IDC ranked in India .
